chapter_mission: Execute the Adumar missile-factory raid; dispatch the Dammant Killers cell; establish Jacen's operational lethality and Nelani's collegial register.
chapter_turn: The team moves from investigation to open action — the Corellian paramilitary presence is no longer deniable and the Jedi-combat register is established.

scene_plan.purpose: Raid and dispatch — Jacen, Ben, and Nelani execute the strike on the missile factory; Dammant Killers dispatched; Nelani registers something off about Jacen's lethality.

exit_vector: Facility destroyed, cell dispatched, team departing Adumar with the first on-page proof that Corellia is arming in the shadows.
notes: One continuous action arc. Jacen's economy of violence — 'one-and-done' dispatch of the cell — registers to Nelani as slightly off without her being able to name it.
